question: Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::? # : LHM :: OKP : %
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] The logic followed here is: Option 1) # = GCH, % = TPU [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04028261682e7d0924998504670b5a714d4c17b339ba6167f616bbc8665a16c6.png] **Follow same logic.** Option 2) # = FDH, % = NHU
